name: Filesystem-Exec-MCP
description: Filesystem tools (read/write/edit/search/move/tree) jailed to chosen directories, plus optional bash/sh/cmd/powershell command execution.
long_description:
A Model Context Protocol server that gives an AI agent a full set of filesystem tools — reading, writing, editing, searching, moving files, and walking directory trees — restricted to one or more directories you choose. It can optionally also expose command-execution tools (`run_bash`, `run_shell`, `run_cmd`, `run_powershell`, `run_command`) that run arbitrary shell commands on the host with your user privileges.

**Command execution is off by default.** Turn it on only if you understand that it grants the connected agent the ability to run anything your user account can run, with no sandboxing beyond the working-directory restriction.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed Directories
allowed_directories.description: Directories this server may read, write, search, and (if enabled) run commands in. Nothing outside these directories is reachable.

allow_exec.title: Enable command execution
allow_exec.description: If enabled, exposes run_bash / run_shell / run_cmd / run_powershell / run_command, which can run ANY command on this machine within the allowed directories. Leave off unless you specifically need it.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read a text file, optionally just head/tail N lines

tools.name: read_media_file
tools.description: Read an image/binary file as base64

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read several files in one call

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Apply find/replace edits, with optional dry run

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory, including parent directories

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List entries directly inside a directory

tools.name: list_directory_with_sizes
tools.description: List directory entries with file sizes, sortable

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Recursive JSON tree of a directory

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Stat a file or directory (size, timestamps, permissions)

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Show the configured allowed root directories

tools.name: run_bash
tools.description: Run a command via /bin/bash -c (only present when command execution is enabled)

tools.name: run_shell
tools.description: Run a command via /bin/sh -c (only present when command execution is enabled)

tools.name: run_cmd
tools.description: Run a command via Windows cmd.exe (only present when command execution is enabled)

tools.name: run_powershell
tools.description: Run a command via PowerShell (only present when command execution is enabled)

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a command via an explicitly chosen shell: bash, sh, cmd, or powershell (only present when command execution is enabled)
